card.name: Past-time framing in narrative text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside sentences that describe the past or an earlier state, such as after 'Before the development of...' or 'In earlier times'. It is also found at points where a past event is being narrated.

modes.label: Opening past-time clause
modes.description: The comma or word that ends a clause setting an earlier period, before the main statement.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'earlier', 'before' and 'initially' and suppresses 'now' and 'nowadays', pushing the text toward past-time wording.
card.plain: It fires when the text is talking about how things were in the past, and steers away from saying 'now'.
